mechanismFindings.source: 宿主应用 app.asar 内的 worktreeTask.checkoutBranch → handleDirtyBeforeCheckout
mechanismFindings.trigger: 切换分支时工作树不干净
mechanismFindings.commitBranchImplementation: git add -A ; git commit -m '[Checkout-checkpoint] from <from> to <to> (HH:MM:SS)'
mechanismFindings.stashBranchImplementation: git stash push -u -m '[Checkout-autostash] before branch switch'
mechanismFindings.conclusion: git add -A 与 git clean -fd 均尊重 .gitignore，因此忽略规则是有效且必要的唯一防线；无需修改宿主程序。
